content.description:
By the community, for the community. A not-pfp collectible of 10000 buildings on the Cardano blockchain, generated with different traits, to build a city gathering the NFT community members around the world together. In a vast city plan, you can have a matchless hill-house or an apartment.

The diversity of the items in DC makes it an exclusive collectible. To make this diversity niftier, this project is coming with airdrops, giveaways, metaverse events, and so on. This project is a gate to enter metaverse.
